title: How to Turn an Interview Into an Offer (6 Things That Actually Work)
description:
If you have an interview coming up, first of all, pause for a second. In this market, getting an interview is a big deal. Now let’s make sure it actually turns into an offer.

Most people don’t mess up interviews because they’re not qualified. They mess them up because they’re not prepared in the right way. And that’s exactly what we’re fixing in this video.

I’m Kate Kirchner, career strategist and your career bestie, and I’m walking you through 6 ways to walk into your interview confident, prepared, and ready to stand out.

You’ll learn:
• The mindset shift that completely changes how you show up in interviews
• How to research a company in a way that actually gives you an edge
• How to use “interview buckets” so you don’t freeze or ramble
• How to ask questions that make hiring managers picture you in the role
• How to practice smarter using AI (not just guess what to prepare)
• The small logistical details that can make or break your performance

If you’ve ever walked out of an interview thinking, “I know I could have done better,” this will help you fix that—and show up the way you’re actually capable of. 

If you need more support creating a resume that gets picked, check out my Get Seen Guide below:
